name: wiki_pairs-humans-completion-benchmark-100
description: A small human-evaluated benchmark of Wikipedia-style text completions that measures how well models produce coherent, context-appropriate continuations. It provides paired examples and human judgments to compare model outputs. Primarily used to evaluate open-ended generation quality on encyclopedic content.
reputation: A niche, small-scale human evaluation set with limited but useful use for fine-grained comparison of generation quality.
